tools.name: get_profile_page
tools.description: Danny Keane's background: a first-person story of his career, then a table with one row per company (role or focus, and a highlight), from the terminal's about command. Returns plain text with Markdown links. The optional section selects story or career; without it, both are returned. The site's /ab

tools.name: get_work_history
tools.description: Danny Keane's roles, newest first: one line each with company, title and years, then side projects and advising. The optional company (a slug from that list) selects one role in detail: title, dates and a first-person account of the work. Returns plain text with Markdown links. get_profile_page has

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get how to reach Danny Keane: email, LinkedIn, Twitter, GitHub, Figma and his investing firm, one channel per line, then his San Francisco local time and usual reply time. Pass channel for one of them. Returns plain text. It only shows the channels; it sends no message.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_profile_page, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_profile_page, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
